user.title: Device type
user.description: A HubIR entity represents one device controlled by one Broadlink remote. Add one entity per device.

climate.title: Add an air conditioner
climate.description: The device code identifies the file of IR codes to use. Device codes are listed in the documentation. To record a new device, use the HubIR panel in the sidebar.

data.name: Name
data.temperature_unit: Temperature unit of the recorded codes
data.power_sensor_restore_state: Restore the last mode when the power sensor turns on
data.power_sensor_reassert: Re-send the state when the power sensor disagrees
data.reassert_interval: Re-send the current state every N minutes (0 = never)

data_description.device_code: A number such as 1020. Codes from 90000 upward are locally recorded.
data_description.controller_data: The remote entity that transmits the codes.
data_description.delay: Time to wait between the codes of a multi-code command.
data_description.temperature_unit: Leave empty to take it from the device file. This is correct for almost all devices.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Optional. Reports the actual room temperature, which infrared cannot.
data_description.power_sensor: Optional. Reports whether the device is actually on.
data_description.power_sensor_reassert: Acts only when the sensor reports off while Home Assistant considers the unit running, which indicates a dropped IR frame. It never switches the unit off: a sensor reporting on usually means the physical remote was used. Waits one minute after any command and stops after three attempts. Requires a sensor that reports more than once per minute.
data_description.reassert_interval: For units that lose their setpoint after a power interruption. Nothing is sent while the entity is off.

switch.description: For an IR device with only on and off states, such as an amplifier, a projector or a heat lamp. The device code identifies the file of IR codes to use. No switch codes are shipped; record the device with the HubIR panel in the sidebar.

data_description.power_sensor: Optional. Reports whether the device is actually on. Recommended for a remote with a single power button.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Transmit a code from a HubIR entity's device file, identified by its command path. Intended for buttons the entity does not model, such as a menu key, an arrow or an LED toggle. Does not change the entity's state.

command.name: Command
command.description: Path to the code, separated by '/'. For example 'extras/menu', 'presets/turbo', 'sources/HDMI1' or 'cool/low/16'.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: Number of times to transmit the code, for example to step the volume.

send_code.name: Send code
send_code.description: Transmit a raw code through a Broadlink remote without a HubIR entity, for codes not yet held in a device file.

remote_entity_id.name: Remote
remote_entity_id.description: The Broadlink remote entity to transmit through.

code.name: Code
code.description: One code, or a list of codes to transmit in turn. A list is how a two-packet toggle button is stored.

encoding.name: Encoding
encoding.description: The encoding of the code. The panel records Base64.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Seconds to wait between the codes of a list.
